reviews.t: Another MUST TRY from Etude House!
reviews.x: This is a review for all three of the moisturizers.  Green Tea - This mask is for people who deal with excess sebum. That being said, I use this one the most. Not only does my skin feel hydrated instead of greasy in the morning, but after the third use I noticed less breakouts around my chin and jawline (I have hormonal acne and horribly sensitive skin). Black Tea : This mask improves elasticity of the skin. I haven't used this long enough to notice a huge difference, but my skin does feel plump

Two days ago, I noticed I had a few pimples on my face, so I applied this before bed. I woke up with more pimples and thought, "Maybe I'm just having a hormonal breakout or something." So I used it again last night. This morning I DEFINITELY woke up with more pimples, especially on my forehead close to m

This is my first "sleeping pack". I bought this because I was looking for something to keep my face moisturized during sleep. What sold me was the cute packaging and the Etude House name. I've read a lot of good reviews on Etude House products, so I wanted to give this a try. The product itself looks gel-like and comes with tapioca pearls at the bottom that you scoop out with a small spoon that is provided. My fiance asked me if he could eat them...I do not advise that you do (haha). T

reviews.t: Easy to use, nice results, cute packaging
reviews.x: I purchased the Etude House Bubble Tea Sleeping Pack in Green Tea and so far I love it.  The packaging is so cute looking like a cup of bubble tea and a spatula that attaches to the outside of the lid looking like a straw.  The gel consistency reminds me of pudding and the bubbles are easier to break if you find the seam.  Don't worry if you see pieces of them as they will melt into the skin.  After massaging it in it does not feel tacky, just feels like a night cream.  I was concerned about a m

This one i bought because it is meant to hydrate the skin, I have dry skin. It has a watery consistency that feels good and hydrating on my skin, absorbs quickly, and effectively moisturizes my face until I wash it off in the morning. My acne scars have faded and I have seen no new breakouts since I started. I suffer from hormonal acne and have for about six years- without finding a regimen that fits until now. For anyone who wants to try it- I use Alba Botanical Ac

I do see a change in my skin tone. This could also be due to the combination of products I am using. So, one night after just washing my face, I used the pack and saw the same progress in skin tone the next morning. My skin has never looked better! I am not sure if this item is 100% responsible for my skin starting to clear up and my pores getting smaller or if it has more to do with adding a nightly routine to my skin care. Either way, I am very happy with the results. The formula is soothing and the packaging is outrageously cute. Adding this product into my skin care routine has made me much more accountable in taking care of my skin at night. I enjoy having fun products that encourage me to use them on

reviews.t: Perfect for boba lovers. Too cute!
reviews.x: I mainly bought it because the packaging is so freakin' cute but the product has a nice scent too and makes my skin nice and soft. I think the people complaining about the product being too sticky on their skin are using way to much. The instructions say to break up one "boba" into a spoonful of the matcha cream and apply it to your face but that's a ton of product. I used just enough for a thin layer on my face and saved the rest. It dried in a minute or two so I wasn't feeling sticky a

Love this puppy. Very worth the money. I don't find my face getting oily like I normally would with moisturising products. The beads are for added moisturising effects so don't worry that there aren't that many. My skin is so soft and clear. A much loved addition to my nightly routine.
Not sure it does everything it says it does, but it makes me feel fancy, so there's that.

Not the greatest incentive, but I really wanted to like this since I love boba, green tea, & am a sucker for cute packaging. My face simply did not agree with this product--after awhile I began to break out severely with no other change in my skincare routine. It does feel very hydrating when applied & the scent is nice without being overwhelming. I read the green tea pack helps with sebum control; unfortunately, my combination oily skin begs to differ. I will be keeping the cup though, so cute

reviews.t: Also nice that it doesn't feel sticky when it's dry - ...
reviews.x: Refreshing when you put it on, and dries quickly so it's not icky on your pillow case. Also nice that it doesn't feel sticky when it's dry - it just feels like I put on lotion. The packaging is really cute (real reason I bought it), and the bubbles inside are a fun touch. My skin feels more elastic after use. Only complaint is that the fragrance is quite strong. Thankfully, the smell is actually pretty nice and greatly reduced when it's dry, so it doesn't hang around for too long.

I have tried literally everything from my skin to proscription to over the counter. So, on a whim of wanting to try a new sleeping mask cause my last made me break out to high heaven. I was extremely surprised to find out that after 1 night I noticed a difference in my stubborn acne. After a week my face has looked better than it has in a very long time. A small amount does go a long way and I do use it every night. I will be buying again

reviews.t: my face always feels so nice in the mornings
reviews.x: This product has been a miracle worker for me! Even when I don't always crush the 'bubbles' and just use the green gel part, my face always feels so nice in the mornings! Make sure to kind of let it get tacky or more dry before laying down though if you're prone to moving in bed like I am- otherwise the product won't penetrate and instead end up all over your pillow. I usually put it on half an hour before bed and have a fan directly on it to help it absorb. It will tingle sometimes if you've go

Ingredients list does not state that this product contains tea tree oil. When asked if the product contained tea tree oil, the company stated that it did not. I'm one of the few who are severely allergic to tea tree oil, and had an anaphylactic reaction to this product.  The product is scented, so I could not smell the tea tree oil. That being said, the product did moisturize my skin without excess oil. I'm now afraid to buy anything from Etude House, due to the fear that tea tree oil will be in

reviews.t: This product is just super cute and fun
reviews.x: This product is just super cute and fun. you only need a very little bit of product so It should last me a very long time. Leaves my face very shiny when it dries (like wet shiny not greasy shiny) but as you put it on to go to bed this doesn't bother me at all. It hasn't caused a breakout yet ( use 1/2 times a week for the last 6 weeks or so) and I don't have to do a full cleanse (oil/cream)  in the morning to remove it- water has been just fine on days I'm in a rush.

Really cute, smells nice, is more of a gel than a typical moisturizer. I use this after cleaning my face with my normal routine, after a shower, before bedtime. I usually rinse it in the morning, before I do my makeup, as I am prone to oily skin. But it soaks in pretty quickly, isn't very heavy and doesn't make my face feel greasy at all. Also doesn't feel harsh on my skin at all.  Nice to use as a pre-bedtime pick me up, to make me feel a little pampered and cute :)

reviews.t: but this is pretty tiny for the price
reviews.x: Be sure you pay attention to the product size! Most people think of huge cups when they hear "bubble tea", but this is pretty tiny for the price. The scent has just a bit of chocolate. I really like that the spatula hooks on to the outside of the lid. So far it's hydrating, but not too occlusive for summer. It dries down nicely, and there seem to be plenty of "boba pearls" for the life of the product. I use about 2 when I put it on.

reviews.t: and it works wonderfully to clear up excess sebum
reviews.x: I've been using this product consistently for a few nights, and it works wonderfully to clear up excess sebum. It also helps reduce redness and acne. Unfortunately, it is also pretty drying and I've woken up in the mornings with (although nicer and clearer skin) lots of dry patches. The packaging is, of course, super cute and I love it. The smell is okay--just a typical lotion scent. Can't wait to get to the bottom boba balls--no idea what they do.

This stuff is amazing i put it on at night after all my other skincare products. I.e Toner, serum, eyecream. And i sleep in it, after i wake up i wash my face and use it before primer and makeup... this in conjuction with my primer makes it look like i have no pores at all. They look very blurred and are pretty much undetectable. It is also very moisterizing... amazing product. MUST TRY

I bought the green tea because of the packaging and my combination acne prone skin. The packaging is very cute as expected. I did not expect my skin to change so drastically after using this product. My skin feels SO soft without the moisture causing acne. Some people complained about the texture of it but honestly it feels great. The smell is very light. Love this product.

Saw rave reviews of this on buzzfeed, they didn't lie. This stuff is super cute on the outside (packaging) yet packs a punch on the inside. My outbreaks are gone. Just stick with it every night, or be a tired lazy gal like me and forget a few night in a row and regret ruining your progress lol.

I have combination but acne prone skin and ordered the green tea pack. It is amazing! I used it for the first time last night and woke up to perfectly hydrated soft skin with no dry patches, no oily patches, no surprise zits for once, and this overall fresh feeling. Definitely worth the money.

claims.text: Many reviewers love the cute bubble tea packaging and find it a major selling point.
Several reviewers report hydrating, moisturizing results and softer, clearer skin.
Some reviewers experienced breakouts or acne after using the product.
A few reviewers mention stickiness or a sticky feel after application.
Some reviewers note there are only a few beads relative to the amount of gel.
